summary: Operator site (home, rates, contact), Good Sam listing, Google, gateways, two Wayback frames read. Back-in $55 + tax is the cheapest electric night; it is a Good Sam Park, so 10% off gives $49.50 and it passes the gate on the discount (no gateway within 40 km). Google 4.0/311. Mixed transient/monthly: monthly $650-675 posted and 'many full time people' per a review, but many outer pull-through pads stood empty in Mar 2026 and Jul 2024. Phone bookings only. Phone '' -> 530-241-0707.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes on Good Sam. The cheapest night a 23-ft rig can book is a back-in, 30/50 A, '$55.00 + tax' (pull-throughs $59); 10% off at a Good Sam Park gives $49.50, at the $50 line. gateways.py: none within 40 km (Lassen 68 km). One Good Sam review says the discount was refused ('charged $70, even though I'm a Good Sam member') - anecdotal.

LONG-STAY TESTS: a nightly rate and phone are posted on its own site and nights are sold, with no application or lease; only 'copying my drivers license' is reported at check-in. It sells weekly and monthly ($650-675) too, and a Good Sam review says 'there are many full time people in the park'. Nightly share estimated from imagery only: in both 2026-03-21 and 2024-07-02 frames the tree-shaded middle rows are mostly full while many outer pull-through pads are empty, so well over 1 in 10 sites looks available for nights. No booking engine exists to measure it properly. No caveat-band call made beyond the note's 'a share of the sites hold monthly residents'.
